high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by Kendall Jenner, taken 4 hours prior to the screenshot being captured. The photo shows a jigsaw puzzle laid out on a wooden table. The puzzle appears to be partially completed, with some pieces already fitted together forming parts of the image, which seems to depict a butterfly and some flowers or leaves. The puzzle is spread across the table, with many pieces still scattered around, indicating that it is in progress.
